# mailboxorg_mails (Data Source)

Lists mail addresses at mailbox.org (`mail.list`), reading every page. Set `domain`, `query`, or both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mailboxorg_mails" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "addresses" {
  value = [for m in data.mailboxorg_mails.example.mails : m.mail]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) List the addresses of this domain.
- `query` (String) Search addresses and names; `%` is a wildcard. The search is scoped to the login: a reseller login finds nothing here, use `domain` instead.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain or query that was listed.
- `mails` (Attributes List) The matching addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mails))

<a id="nestedatt--mails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mails`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (List of String) Alias addresses.
- `capabilities` (List of String) Enabled capabilities.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation date.
- `domain` (String) Its domain.
- `forwards` (List of String) Forwarding targets.
- `mail` (String) The mail address.
- `memo` (String) Free-text memo.
- `plan` (String) Current plan.
- `type` (String) Address type: `forward`, `inbox` or `inboxforward`.
